Twirling Into Style: Tour This Extra Living Space at 5305 English Oak Dr, Killeen TX #realestate 

Step inside the newest listing from Rachel Leslie with the i35 Group and see why this home is full of surprises! Rachel takes you on a spin—literally—through the spacious extra living area complete with a counter, sink, cabinets, and mini fridge. Perfect for entertaining, a guest suite, or your dream hobby space.

📍 Property Address: 5305 English Oak Dr, Killeen, TX 76542
✨ Features of the extra space:

Built-in counter & sink

Cabinets for storage

Convenient mini fridge

Plenty of room for gatherings or relaxation

Whether you’re looking for more room to host, work, or unwind, this versatile living area is a must-see.
